   FIXING BOLT WITH 30mm SPANNER AND DISCONNECT THE HOSE.
   2. HOLD THE ROLLER AND REMOVE THE ROLL FIXING BOLT WITH 30 mm SPANNER.
   3. KEEP THE BOLT ALONG WITH WASHER IN SAFE PLACE.
   4. REMOVE THE OLD ROLLER.
   5. INSERT THE NEW ROLLER THROUGH THE LEVER AND TURN BUCKLE SO THAT THE KEY ON
   THE ROLLER SHAFT MATCHES WITH THE KEYWAY IN THE LEVER.
   6. FIX THE ROLL FIXIONG BOLT ALONG WITH WASHER AND TIGHTEN IT.
   7. CHECK FOR FREE ROTATION.
   8. . IF ROLLER IS NOT FREELY ROTATING CHECK FOR ANY FOULING AND RECTIFY.
   9. FIX THE OAL HOSE AND TIGHTEN NUT WITH 17 mm SPANNER.
   10. OPEN AIR SHUTOFF VALVE.
   11. CHECK WHETHER THE ROLLER IS FREE AT FILING OUT POSITION OR NOT.
   12. IF NOT FREE CHECK FOR ANY FOULING AND RECTIFY BY CHANGING ROLLER IF NECESSARY.

TASK : ECS PUMP REPLACEMENT

SECTION " A "

SECTION " B "




                                                                             4

1. CLOSE SUPPLY AND RETURN VALVES OF THE CONNECTED TURBINE
   2. CLOSE DELIVERY AND SUCTION VALVES OF THE PUMP
   3. ENSURE THAT THE PUMP COMES TO STOP
   4. IF THE PUMP DOES NOT STOP,ISOLATING VALVES MAY NOT BE HOLDING
   5. INFORM OPERATION PERSONNEL TO LOWER FURNACE TEMPERATURE,STOP ECS SYSTEM AND
   DRAIN WATER FROM THE SYSTEM.
   6. AFTER WATER IS DRAINED OPEN SUCTION AND DELIVERY FLANGES BOLTS AND FIX DUMMY
   PLATES
   7. TIGHTEN FLANGES BOLTS.
   8. OPEN PUMP COUPLING BOLTS REMOVE SPACER AND KEEP IT SAFELY
   9. OPEN PUMP FIXING BOLTS ON HOUSING WITH 65 SLOGGING SPANNER
   10. THE BOTTOM MOST BOLT ON THE HOUSING MUST BE OPENED WITH THE HELP OF
   HYDRAULIC JACK.
   11. REMOVE ALL BOLTS AND KEEP THEM SAFELY.
   12. SLING THE PUMP TO THE MONO -RAIL HOIST AND HOIST TILL THE SLING IS TAUT.
   13. CLOSE COOLING WATER VALVES TO THE PUMP AND DISCONNECT PIPE LINES TO PUMP.
   14 REMOVE THE BEARING PEDESTAL FIXING BOLTS AND KEEP THEM SAFELY.
   15. SLOWLY HOIST THE PUMP AND PULL OUT THE PUMP FROM HOUSING.
   NOTE:DO NOT DISTURB THE SHIMS UNDER PUMP PEDESTAL
   16. SHIFT THE PUMP SIDE BASE AND PLACE IT ON A TROLLY.
   17. TRANSPORT THE TROLLY TO FLOOR OPENING AND LIFT THE PUMP TO THE TOP BY EOT
   CRANE
   18. PLACE THE NEW PUMP ON THE TROLLY AND SHIFTED TO POSITION.
   19. SLING IT TO MONO RAIL HOIST,LIFT IT ,MOVE IT, TO THE HOUSING.
   20. INSERT THE PUMP CARE FULLY INTO THE HOUSING.
   21. LOCATE BOLT HOLES AND FIX BOLTS.

   28. OPEN FLANGE BOLTS,REMOVE DUMMIES AND RETIGHTEN FLANGE BOLTS
   NOTE:ENSURE THAT NO WATER IS PRESENT IN THE PIPE LINES
   29. FILL OIL SERVO MESH 150 IN THE BEARING HOUSING UPTO THE MARKED LEVER IN THE
   CONSTANT LEVEL GAUGE.

                                                  JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : Lever Type pusher beam changing

  SECTION " A "

   1. Ensure that new beam is in properly assembled condition

  SECTION " B "

   1.  Close the air shut-off valve and drain the air in the cylinder.
   2.  Remove lock plate fixing screws of the connecting pin
   3.  If lock plate is tack welded, gas cut and remove the lock plate
   4.  Remove the pin by hammering using M 24 bolt from one side.
   5.  After the pin is removed, sling the beam
   6.  Operate cross travel of the crane and gradually pull out the beam.
   7.  Remove the beam and keep it in a safe place
   8.  Sling the new beam and insert into the frame with crane
   9.  Smothen the bore of the lever and beam with emery paper
   10. Match the bores of the lever and beam and insert new pin
   11. Hammer in the new pin taking care that its end does not bulge
        Note : Check the orientation of the slot in the pin matches for fixing lock plate
   12. Fix lock plate and tighten fixing screws
   13. Open air valve and check foe smooth operation

  TASK : FIXING-OUT ROLLER TURNBUCKLE CHANGING

  SECTION " A "

   1. SCANNER TO BE TURNED 180 DEGREES BEFORE STARTING JOB AND MUST BE FIXED BACK IN
   ORIGINAL POSITION AFTER
      COMPLETION OF JOB.
   2. STOPPER LEVER MUST BE PLACED IN THE SLOT AFTER LIFTING THE PROTECTION HOOD.
   3. AIR SHUTOFF VALVE MUST BE CLOSED AND AIR MUST BE DRAINED COMPLETELY.
   4. NEW ROLLER MUST BE FREELY ROTATING

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN THE OAL HOSE CONNECTION THE ROLLER WITH 17mm SPANNER LOCKING THE ROLL
   FIXING BOLT WITH 30mm SPANNER AND DISCONNECT THE HOSE.
   2. HOLD THE ROLLER AND REMOVE THE ROLL FIXING BOLT WITH 30 mm SPANNER.
   3. KEEP THE BOLT ALONG WITH WASHER IN SAFE PLACE.
   4. REMOVE THE OLD ROLLER.
   5. OPEN THE KEEPER PLATE BOLTS AND KEEP THE PLATE SAFELY.
   6. REMOVE THE PIN AND SLIDE OUT THE TURNBUCKLE FROM CONNECTING LEVER.
   7. SLIDE IN THE NEW TURNBUCKLE ON THE CONNECTING LEVER AND ALIGN THE HOLES.
   8. INSERT THE PIN USING BRASS HAMMER KEEPING THE SLOT ON THE PIN IN ALIGNMENT WITH
   FIXING SCREW HOLES ON THE LOCK
       PLATE.
   9. INSERT THE NEW ROLLER THROUGH THE LEVER AND TURN BUCKLE SO THAT THE KEY ON
   THE ROLLER SHAFT MATCHES WITH THE KEYWAY IN THE LEVER.
   10. FIX THE ROLL FIXIONG BOLT ALONG WITH WASHER AND TIGHTEN IT.
   11. CHECK FOR FREE ROTATION.
   12. . IF ROLLER IS NOT FREELY ROTATING CHECK FOR ANY FOULING AND RECTIFY.
   13. FIX THE OAL HOSE AND TIGHTEN NUT WITH 17 mm SPANNER.
   14. OPEN AIR SHUTOFF VALVE.
   15. CHECK WHETHER THE ROLLER IS FREE AT FILING OUT POSITION OR NOT.
   16. IF NOT FREE CHECK FOR ANY FOULING AND RECTIFY BY CHANGING ROLLER IF NECESSARY.
   17. .REMOVE STOPPER LAVER AND LOWER PROTECTION HEAD.

                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : INSPECTION OF OIL AIR SYSTEM

  SECTION " A "

   1. KEEP CENTRAL PUMP STATION IN "ON" CONDITION
   2.KEEP THE SYSTEM IN "REMOTE" AND "DC" CONTACTORS OF MAIN STANDS IN ON CONDITION
   3.CARRY OUT THIS PROCEDURE ONLY WHEN THERE IS STOPPAGE OF ROLLING IN MILL AFTER
   INFORMING SHIFT -IN-CHARGE (OPERN)

  SECTION " B "

    1.CHECK THAT THE MAIN PUMP STATION PUMP IS STARTING AND STOPPING NORMALLY
   NOTE:THE PUMP MUST BE START WHEN PRESSURE GOES BELOW 40 BAR AND IT MUST BE STOP
   WHEN PRESSURE GOES ABOVE 80 BAR
   2.CHECK OIL LEVEL OF MAIN TANK
   NOTE:OIL LEVEL MUST BE BETWEEN MIN and MAX MARKED ON TANK
   3.TOP UP OIL IF OIL LEVEL IS BELOW MINIMUM
   4.CHECK AT SATELLITE STATION FOR START OF TURBOLUB LUBRICATION TO ON AT SET TIMES
   NOTE:SET TIME FOR ROUGHING STANDS IS 1 MIN AND IT IS 2 MIN FOR OTHERS
   5.CHECK THAT THE AIR PRESSURE IS ABOVE 3 BAR AT SATELLITE STATIONS
   6.IF AIR PRESSURE IS BELOW 3 BAR ADJUST REGULATOR AND CLEAN FILTER ELEMENT AFTER
   PRESSURE DOES NOT IMPROVING AFTER FLOW
   7.CHECK OIL FLOW IN TRANSPARENT TUBES BELOW MIXING BLOCK
   NOTE: A) FREE FLOW OF OIL WITH WHIRLING ACTION INDICATES THAT THE SYSTEM IN HEALTHY
          B)IF ANY TUBE IS FULL OF OIL IT INDICATES THAT THE QRC IS NOT PROPERLY
   CONNECTED TO THE STAND AND FLOW IS BLOCKED
   8.RECTIFY THE BLOCKED FLOW BY REPLACING DEFECTIVE QRC
   9. IF NO FLOW IS OBSERVED AT BEARINGS ,BUT OIL FLOW IN SATELLITE STATION IS NORMAL
   THEN CHECK FOR LEAKS IN PIPE LINES AND FOR CHOCKING IN DISTRUBUTOR
   10.TAKE A REMIDIAL ACTION BY REPLACING PIPELINES OR DISTRBUTOR TO ESTABLISH OIL
   FLOW
   11.TIGHTEN HOSE CLAMPS IF OIL IS LEAKIGN AT HOSE CONNECTIONS TO BEARING POINTS

1. CLEAN AND DEGREASE THE FOLLOWING
                    - THE FOLLOWING SHAFT OF THE GEAR BOX

                     - 78 DIA AND 80 DIA BEARING SURFACES ON ROLLER SHAFT
   2. CHECK THE SURFACE CONDITION OF THE ABOVE ELEMENTS.THEY MUST BE SMOOTH AND
   POLISHED
   3. CHANGE THE SHRUNK ON RING IF WORN OUT OR CORRODED
   4. MEASURE THE DIAMETER OF THE SHAFT THEY MUST BE WITHIN TOLERABLE LIMITS
   NOTE: A) TOLERANCE ARE 88f7,80h6,78h8,80H7
          B) IF NOT WITHIN LIMITS,THE ROLLER MUST BE CHANGED AS PER JOB PROCEDURE NO
   44/04
   5. ALL THE ELEMENTS OF THE GEARBOX FIXING STUDS WASHERS AND TORQUE ARM MUST BE
   CLEANED.
   6. LEVEL THE TOP SURFACE OF THE GEARBOX FIXING BRACKET BY SPIRIT LEVEL AND TIGHTEN
   FIXING BOLTS
   7. CHANGE THE COUPLING SPIDER IF DAMAGED
   8. INSERT THE GEARBOX ON THE ROLLER SHAFT AND SET IT AGAINST THE STEP ON THE ROLLER
   BY HAND
   NOTE: A) LUBRICANTS MUST NOT BE USED FOR INSTALLATION
           B) AVOID USE OF HAMMER ON GEAR BOX FOR INSTALLATION
   9. MATCH THE HOLES OF THE GEAR BOX TORQUE ARM AND FIXING BRACKET BY SHIMMING THE
   BRACKET
   10. CLEAN AND DEGREASE ALL PARTS OF SHRUNK ON RING
   11. LUBRICATE SHRUNK ON RING SCREWS WITH MOLYCOTE BR2 GREASE
   12. ASSEMBLE THE SHRUNK ON RING BY TIGHTENING SLIGHTLY 3 SCREWS 120 DEGREES APART
   LEAVING THE BICONICAL BUSHING FREE TO ROTATE
   13. SLIDE THE SHRUNK ON RING ON THE WORM WHEEL HUB
   NOTE: WORM WHEEL HUB 88 DIA AND SHRUNK ON RING BORE MUST BE IN DEGREASED
   CONDITION
   14. TIGHTEN SHRUNK ON RING SCREWS UNIFORMLY TO 0.6 DA NM IN ANTI-CLOCKWISE
   DIRECTION
   15. INSTALL A NEW SEAL IN WATER BOX AND APPLY GREASE
   16. INSTALL WATERBOX OUTLET UPWARDS AND TIGHTEN BOLTS
   17. INSTALL WATER INLET FLANGE AND TIGHTEN BOLTS
   18. INSTALL GEAR BOX FIXING STUD FROM BOTTOM
   NOTE: REFER DRAWING NO A10-1001.S42-1649
   19. TIGHTEN M27 NUT TO 2KGM TORQUE AND FIX LOCKNUTS M20 AND M27
   20. FILL OIL IN GEARBOX(1 LTR APPROX)
   21. OPEN INLET COOLING WATER VALVE
   22. CHECK FOR FREE ROTATION OF ROLLER WHEN INPUT SHAFT IS ROTATED BY HAND
   23. IF ROLLER IS NOT FREE CHECK FOR ANY FOULLING WITH INLET FLANGE AND RECTIFY
   24. RE-INSTALL THE MOTOR USING 8mm WIRE ROPE SLING WITH EOT CRANE
   25. TIGHTEN MOTOR FIXING STUDS

   13. INSTALL INLET FLANGE

                                            JOB PROCEDURE
TASK : Wire rope changing of Jessop crane in DE EF bays

SECTION " A "

 1. TRANSPORT THE NEW ROPE OF THR REQUIRED LENGTH TO WORK SITE
 2. CHECK CONDITION OF NEW ROPE and ITS THIMBLE

SECTION " B "

 REMOVAL OF OLD ROPE:
 1) LOWER THE MAGNET ON TO THE GROUND and FURTHER LOWER NTHE HOIST TILL ONLY ONE
 ROUND OF WIRE ROPE IS LEFT 0N THE ROPE DRUMS. NOTE: ONE PERSON SHOULD ALWAYS
 CHEK ROPE POSITION ON ROPE DRUM and INSTRUCT THR OPERTOR FOR LOWERING.
 2) REMOVE THE TWO ROPE DRUM END CLAMPS BLOCKS WITH 32 and 36 RING SPANNER. NOTE:
 BEWARE OF ROPE JUMPINH and FALLING DOWN WHEN CLAMP IS OPEN.
 3) REMOVE THE SPLIT PIN FROM ROPE TIE ROD PIN WITH CUTTING PLAYER.
 4) REMOVE THE PIN FROM WIRE ROPE THIMBLE WITH SREW DRIVER and SPANNER.
 5) REMOVE THE OLD ROPE TO THE SCRAP DISPOSAL AREA.



 FIXING OF NEW ROPE:

 1) USING THE MANILA ROPE LIFT THE THIMBLE END OF THE NEW ROPE TO THE TOP.
 2) LOCATE THE THIMBLE IN THE TIE ROD and INSERT TIE ROD PIN THROUH THE THE TIE ROD and
 THIMBLE.
 3) FIX THE SPLIT PIN and FLARE OUT THE FREE ENDS WITH SCREW DRIVER
 4) TIE THE GI WIRE TO OTHER END OF THE NEW ROPE
 5) PASS THE GI WIRE AROUND THE LOWER BEAM PULLEY and PIL IT OUT ALONG THE WIRE ROPE
 6)TIE THE MANILA ROPE TO THE PULLED OUT END and LIFT THE ROPE TO THE ROPE DRUM
 7) FIX THE ROPE ON THE ROPE DRUM ,FIX CLAMP and TIGHTEN THE CLAMP BOLTS. NOTE:
 ROUTING OF THE ROPE AROUND THE PULLYS MIST BE DONE AS PER DRAWING NO:10184
 8) HOIST THE MAGNET BEAM TO `100MM ABOVE THE GROUN and CHECK THE LEVEL. NOTE:
 BEAM SHOULD BE PARRELL TO THE GROUND.
 9) IF THE BEAM IS NOT PARALLEL ADJUST LEVEL BY SLACKING / TIGHTENING WIRE ROPE ON
 THE ROPE DRUM.




 Note: YOU MUST ALWAYS LEAVE THE AREA YOU HAVE BEEN WORKING IN CLEAN,TIDY AND IN A
 SAFE CONDITION.

                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : ROLLERS CHANGING

  SECTION " A "

   1. ENSURE THAT THE NEW ROLLER IS FREELY ROTATING.
   2. ENSURE THAT THE NON DRIVE BEARING BLOCK OF NEW ROLLER IS FILLED WITH SP680
   OIL(1.5 LIT)

  SECTION " B "

   1. REMOVE THE GRILL ON THE FLOOR PLATE COVERING THE DRIVE MOTOR OF THE ROLLER TO
   BE CHANGED .
   2. LOOSEN THE FOUR BOLTS FIXING THE MOTOR TO THE ROLLER GEAR BOX.
   3. REMOVE TWO BOLTS AT THE BOTTOM.
   NOTE: COLLECT THE OIL COMING OUT OF THE GEARBOX IN THE CAN
   4. SLING THE WIRE ROPE AROUND THE MOTOR AND FIX A D-SHACKLE.
   5. PLACE THE OTHER END OF THE SLING ON THE CRANE HOOK AND GRADUALLY HOIST TILL
   THE SLING IS SLIGHTLY TIGHT.
    NOTE: HOISTING AT HIGH SPEED MUST BE STRICTLY AVOIDED AS OTHERWISE FIXING BOLTS
   MAY SHEAR
   7. TAKE OUT THE MOTOR AND KEEP IT SAFELY.
   8. SLING THE APRON PLATE ON THE ROLLER AND USE CRANE TO REMOVE THE ARPON PLATE.
   9. FIX THE SLING ON EITHER END OF THE BEARING BLOCKS OF THE ROLLER AND SLOWLY LIFT
   THE ROLLER.
    NOTE : ENSURE THAT THECRANE HOOK IS CENTRALLY PLACED OVER THE ROLLER.
   10. REMOVE THE ROLLER AND KEEP IT AT SAFE PLACE .
   11. SLING THE NEW ROLLER AND PLACE IT IN POSITION.
    NOTE : ENSURE THAT THE BEARING BLOCKS ARE PROPERLY SEATED AND ROLLER IS ROTATING
   FREELY.
   12. FIX BACK THE ARPHON PLATE.
   13. FIX THE MOTOR AND TIGHTEN THE FIXING BOLTS UNIFORMLY.
   14. POUR SP680 OIL APPROX. 3 TO 5 LITERS IN THE GEARBOX.
    NOTE: CHECK OIL LEVEL WITH DIP STICK
   15. CHECK FOR FREE ROTATION OF THE ROLLER
   16. INSTALL THE GRALL BACK ON THE FLOOR PLATE.

   ARMATURE FLUSHES WITH THE SURFACE OF THE ARMATURE.
   4. TURN THE BOLT ANTICLOCKWISE ON THE WEDGE AGAINST THE INNER ARMATURE WITH 24
   MM SPANNER TILL THE INNER ARMATURE AND THE SOUNDING PIN FLUSH OR COME TO SAME
   LEVEL.
   5. IF THE LEVEL OF THE SOUNDING PINS IS ABOVE BOTH THE ARMATURES THE FOLLOWING
   ADJUSTMENTS MUST BE DONE.
   6. LOOSEN NUT ON PULLROD WITH 30 MM SPANNER TILL OUTER ARMATURE AND SOUNDING
   PIN FLUSH.

   SPANNER TILL THE INNER ARMATURE AND THE SOUNDING PIN FLUSH.
   8. CHECK THAT THE TORQUE ADJUSTER WASHER FACE STANDS CLEAR OF THE OUTER
   ARMATURE SURFACE.
   9. IF THERE IS NO CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TORQUE ADJUSTER WASHER FACE AND OUTER
   ARMATURE ,BRAKE LINERS NEED REPLACEMENT.

   2. ENSURE THAT AFTER NEW COTTOR PIN IS FIXED, FREE ENDS ARE OPENED OUT TO PREVENT

   OF THE CHAIN TOGETHER.

   TENSION IF NECESSARY.
   5. FIX THE COTTOR PINS AND FLATE OUT THE FREE ENDS.
   6. TENSION THE CHAIN TO SUCH AN EXTENT THAT THE MIDDLE PORTION OF THE CHAIN
   CANNOT BE LIFTED MORE THAN 75MM BY HAND.

                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : CHANGING OF BRAKE SLIDE APRONS 1 2

  SECTION " A "

   1. ALL SLIDING SURFACES MUST BE PROPERLY CLEANED AND POLISHED WITH EMERY PAPER.
   2. ENSURE THAT THE LOCATING HOLES IN THE NEW BRAKESLIDES ARE FREE OF BURRS AND
   BORES ARE SMOOTH.
   3. ENSURE THAT THE BRAKESLIDES ARE IN THE TOP MOST POSITION AND DRIVE CRANKS ARE
   PROPERLY IMMOBOLISED.

  SECTION " B "

   1. ROTATE THE BRAKESLIDE LOCATING PIN BY 45 DEGREES IN COUNTER CLOCKWISE
   DIRECTION.
   2. PULL OUT THE PIN CATCHING THE EYE BOLT WELDED TO THE PIN BY 50 MM.
   3. ROTATE BACK THE PIN BY 45 DEGREES CLOCKWISE.
   4. GRADUALLY PULL OUT THE PIN TILL A CLICK SOUND IS HEARD AND THEN ROTATE PIN BY 90
   DEG CLOCKWISE.
   5. LIFT THE BRAKESLIDE UP WITH THE HELP OF PIPES FOR GREATER LEVERAGE.
   6. REMOVE THE BRAKESLIDE AND POLISH THE SLIDING SURFACES ON THE LEVER WITH FINE
   EMERY PAPER.
   7. CLEAN THE PIN WITH DIESEL AND APPLY A THIN COAT OF MOLYCOTE 321 R LUBRICANT
   SPARAY ON IT.
   8. APPLY A THIN COAT OF MOLYCOTE 321 R SPRAY ON SLIDING SURFACES OF THE LEVER AND
   THE NEW BRAKESLIDE.
   9. INSERT THE PIN INTO THE NEW BRAKESLIDE AND MATCH THE SQUARE ON THE PIN WITH
   SLOT.
   10. PLACE THE BRAKESLIDE ALONG WITH PIN ON THE LEVER AND GRADUALLY PUSH IT IN.
   11. AFTER THE BRAKESLIDE IS PROPERLY SEATED ROATE THE PIN BY 90 DEG .COUNTER
   CLOCKWISE.
   12. PUSH THE PIN FULLY INSIDE AND ROTATE IT BY 90 DEG TO LOCK IT.

                                 STANDDARD MAINTENANCE PROCEDURE
                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : CHAIN BEARING CHANGING

  SECTION " A "

   1. BEFORE TAKING SHUTDOWN POSITION THE DOG SUCH THAT THE DOG WHERE THE
   CARRYING LINK TO BE CHANGED IS 5 LINKS DOWNSTREAM OF IDLE SPROCKET.
   2. ENSURE THAT LEVER TYPE PUSHER AND BLOOM TAKE OFF ARE DEPRESSURISED.

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN TENSION IN THE CHAIN BY LOOSENING TENSION BOLTS WITH 36 RING SPANNER.
   2. PASS THE 8MM SLING THROUGH THE SECOND LINK ON EITHER SIDE OF CARRYING LINKS TO
   FORM A CHOCKER HITCH.
   3. CONNECT THE EYE OF THE SLING TO MAX PULLER.
   5. TIGHTEN THE MAX PULLER SO THAT TE CHOCKER HITCH TIGHTENS AND LOAD OF THE CHAIN
   IS TAKEN.
   6. SLING THE CARRYING LINK SLOWLY HOIST WITH CRANE TILL THE SLING JUST TAKES ITS
   LOAD.
   7. REMOVE THE CIRCLIPS AND SLIDE OUT LINK PLATES.
   8. UNSCREW THE ALLAN SCREW AND TAKE OUT THE LINK PINS.
   9. LIFT CARRYING LINK WITH CRANE AND KEEP IT IN A SAFE PLACE.
   10. SLING THE NEW CARRYING LINK AND POSITION IT IN THE CHAIN.
   11. INSERT NEW PINS AND BEARINGS AND TIGHTEN ALLAN SCREWS.
   12. CHANGE CHAIN LINK PLATES IF DAMAGED.
   13. ALIGN LINK PLATES AND FIX MECHANICAL CIRCLIP.
   14. LOOSEN THE MAX PULLER AND TAKE OUT THE SLING.
   15. TENSION THE CHAIN TO THE REQUIRED EXTENT.
   16. RELEASE SHUT DOWN AND OPERATE ELEVATOR.
   17 TENSION THE CHAIN AGAIN IF REQUIRED.

   2. ENSURE THAT THE NEW WHEELS ARE ROTATING FREELY ON THE AXLES.

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN ROPE TENSION BY LOOSENING THE TENSION PULLEY.
   2. OPEN THE BULLDOG GRIP BOLTS ON THE FRONT ROPE OF THE DOG CARRIAGE TO BE
   REVISIONED.
   3. REMOVE THE FRONT ROPE FROM THE DOG CARRIAGE.
   4. USING EOT CRANE PULL OUT THE DOG CARRIAGE FROM BEAMS AND KEEP IT IN A SAFE
   PLACE.
   5. GAS CUT THE DAMAGED AXLE LOCK WASHERS.
   6. REMOVE THE WHEELS ALONGWITH THE AXLES.
   7. SMOOTHEN THE BORES AND NEW AXLES WITH EMERY PAPER.
   8. INSERT THE NEW WHEELS ALONGWITH THE AXLES.
        NOTE: ENSURE THAT THE AXLE IS PROPERLY POSITIONED.
   9. WELD WASHERS TO LOCK THE AXLE AGAINST DIAPLACEMENT.
        NOTE: THE WHEELS MUST BE ROTATING FREELY.
   10. INSERT THE NEW CARRIAGE IN THE BEAMS WITH EOT CRANE.
   11. POSITION THE DOG CARRIAGE SO THAT IT IS ALIGNED WITH OTHER CARRIAGES.
   12. PASS THE FRONT ROPE THROUGH THE THIMBLE ON THE DOG CARRIAGE.
   13. FIX THE FREEEND OF THE ROPE TO A MAXPULLER PULLING ROPE AND TIGHTEN BULLDOG
   GRIPS.
   14. FIX THE OTHER END OF THE MAXPULLER TO THE ROLLER TABLE BASE FRAME.
   15. ARREST THE FORWARD MOVEMENT OF THE DOG CARRIAGE BY FIXING SUITABLE WEDGES.
   16. TIGHTEN THE MAXPULLER TILL THE DOG CARRIAGE ROPE IS TENSIONED TO REQUIRED
   EXTENT.
   17. FIX BULLDOG GRIPS AND TIGHTEN THEM FULLY.
   18. LOOSEN MAXPULLER ROPE FIXING BULLDOG GRIPS AND CHECK DOG CARRIAGE
   ALIGNMENT.
   19. REMOVE THE CARRIAGE ARRESTING WEDGES.. REMOVE THE MAXPULLER.
   21. TENSION THE ROPE TO THE REQUIRED EXTENT.

                                 STANDDARD MAINTENANCE PROCEDURE
                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : CHANGING OF DAMAGED CHAIN AND TENSIONING

  SECTION " A "

   1. DO NOT USE REMOVED COTTOR PINS AGAIN.
   2. ENSURE THAT AFTER PIN IS FIXED, FREE ENDS ARE OPENED OUT.
   3. ENSURE THAT THE NEW CHAIN CONFIRMS TO THE DRAWING.

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN THE TENSION BOLT LOCKNUT AND LOOSEN THE TENSION OF THE CHAIN.
   2. REMOVE THE COTTOR PINS AND DISCONNECT CHAIN.
   3. REMOVE THE CHAIN FROM THE BEAM AND KEEP IT IN A SAFE PLACE.
   4. TRANSPORT THE NEW CHAIN AND PLACE IT ON THE BEAM.
   5. ALIGN THE PROJECTED LINKS ON THE CHAIN TO THE ADJACENT PROJECTED LINKS ON THE
   REMAINING CHAINS.
   6. ENSURE THAT THE CHAIN IS PLACED PORPERLY ON DRIVE AND IDLE SPROCKETS.
   7. INSERT THE NEW BREAKING LINK TO CONNECT THE TWO ENDS. LOOSEN TENSION IF
   NECESSARY.
   8. FIX THE COTTOR PINS AND FLARE OUT THE FREE ENDS.
   9. TENSION THE CHAIN TO SUCH AN EXTENT THAT THE CHAIN CANNOT BE LIFTED BY HAND
   IN THE MIDDLE
   10. CHECK WHETHER THE PROJECTED LINK ON THE CHAIN IS IN ALIGNMENT WITH THOSE OF
   THE REMAINING CHAINS.
   11. IF NOT ALIGNED REALIGN BY ADVANCING OR RETRACTING ONE LINK OVER THE IDLE
   SPROCKET.
   12. CHECK TENSION AGAIN AS IN STEP 9.

  TASK : CARRYING LINK CHANGING

  SECTION " A "

   BEFORE TAKING SHUTDOWN POSITION THE DOG SUCH THAT THE DOG WHERE THE CARRYING
   LINK TO BE CHANGED IS 5 LINKS DOWNSTREAM OF IDLE SPROCKET.
   2.ENSURE THAT LEVER TYPE PUSHER AND BLOOM TAKE OFF ARE DEPRESSURISED.

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN TENSION IN THE CHAIN BY LOOSENING TENSION BOLT WITH 36 RING SPANNER.
   2. PASS THE 8MM SLING THROUGH THE SECOND LINK ON EITHER SIDE OF CARRYING LINKS
   TO FORM A CHOCKER HITCH.
   3. CONNECT THE EYE OF THE SLING TO MAX PULLER.
   4. FIX THE MAX PULLER TO THE COLUMN AT 0M LEVEL.
   5. TIGHTEN THE MAX PULLER SO THAT TE CHOCKER HITCH TIGHTENS AND LOAD OF THE CHAIN
   IS TAKEN.
   6. SLING THE CARRYING LINK SLOWLY HOIST WITH CRANE TILL THE SLING JUST TAKES ITS
   LOAD.
   7. REMOVE THE CIRCLIPS AND SLIDE OUT LINK PLATES.
   8. UNSCREW THE ALLAN SCREW AND TAKE OUT THE LINK PINS.
   9. LIFT CARRYING LINK WITH CRANE AND KEEP IT IN A SAFE PLACE.
   10. SLING THE NEW CARRYING LINK AND POSITION IT IN THE CHAIN.
   11. INSERT NEW PINS AND BEARINGS AND TIGHTEN ALLAN SCREWS.
   12. CHANGE CHAIN LINK PLATES IF DAMAGED.
   13. ALIGN LINK PLATES AND FIX MECHANICAL CIRCLIP.
   14. LOOSEN THE MAX PULLER AND TAKE OUT THE SLING.
   15. TENSION THE CHAIN TO THE REQUIRED EXTENT.
   16. RELEASE SHUT DOWN AND OPERATE ELEVATOR.
   17 TENSION THE CHAIN AGAIN IF REQUIRED.

  TASK : INSPECTION OF LUBE OIL SYSTEM ON A SHUTDOWN DAY

  SECTION " A "

   1. KEEP THE LUBE OIL SYSTEM IN RUNNING CONDITION.

  SECTION " B "

   1. CHECK THE PRESSURES AT INDIVIDUAL GEARBOXES.
   2. IF PRESSURE IS NOT BETWEEN 1.5 TO 1.7 BAR ADJUST INLET VALVES TO ATTAIN THE
   REQUIRED PRESSURE.
   3. OBSERVE FOR WETTING OR LEAKAGES AT VARIOUS GEARBOXES AND PIPE JOINTS.

   TIGHTENING.
   6. OPEN INSPECTION COVERS OF INDIVIDUAL GEARBOXES AND CHECK FOR OIL FLOW.
   7. CLEAR THE CHOCKED NOZZLES FOR OBTAINING FULL FLOW.

                                 STANDDARD MAINTENANCE PROCEDURE
                                          JOB PROCEDURE
  TASK : FIXING OF BREAKING LINK IN CHAIN AND TENSIONING

  SECTION " A "

   1. DO NOT USE REMOVED COTTOR PINS AGAIN.
   2. ENSURE THAT AFTER NEW COTTOR PIN IS FIXED, FREE ENDS ARE OPENED OUT TO PREVENT
   COTTOR PIN COMING OUT.

  SECTION " B "

   1. LOOSEN THE TENSION BOLT LOCKNUT AND LOOSEN THE TENSION OF THE CHAIN.
   2. REMOVE THE COTTOR PINS AND THE DAMANGED / OLD BREAKING LINK.
   3. LIFT THE CHAIN, IF IT HAS FALLEN DOWN WITH MANILLA ROPE AND BRING THE TWO ENDS
   OF THE CHAIN TOGETHER.
   4. INSERT THE NEW BREAKING LINK TO CONNECT THE TWO ENDS BY LOOSENING THE CHAIN
   TENSION IF NECESSARY.
   5. FIX THE COTTOR PINS AND FLATE OUT THE FREE ENDS.

Title (of the job performed): Repair of worn out rotor shaft of steam turbine.
Profit to the company by settling the issues in time. [       ]
Commendable job, setting new trends in the performance.[ v  ]

In LMMM, evaporative cooling system of Walking beam furnace is provided with 2 nos of steam turbines to cater to the feed water recirculation in ECS circuits. The requirement of steam turbine is most vital especially in case of any power failure and also during initial starting of ECS after any furnace shutdown. The turbines have been running since inception and due to the prolonged use, the wear out of the internals including the rotor shafts has increased.

The proposal to refurbish the worn out shaft with the help of external agencies didn’t materialise as it was too expensive. Instead of going for procurement of a new rotor due to the high cost involved, dept team has revisioned the rotor shaft in-house using powder metallurgy .

The worn out area of the rotor shaft especially the bearing seating area was initially built up by fusewelding using Colmonoy63F alloy powder which was found compatible with the shaft material. The built up surface was then gradually rounded off by grinding, using a jig and fixture arrangement to get a uniformly well rounded shaft.
A spare rotor shaft was made ready with minimum cost with available in house resources.
